system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"WHY DOES THE <USER> WEB BROWSER NEVER WORK!!?? First, my desktop version stopped working, now my browser version won't work. I JUST WANNA LISTEN TO MY THROWBACK THURSDAY PLAYLIST 😭😭😭😭"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Hey! Can you try copying the Album Link from the web player and looking it up on the app? Just click on the 3 dots > Copy Album Link"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply doesn't address the issue or empathize with the customer's frustration."}
